## Overview

Header is a page-level container that combines optional leading and trailing actions with a localized title and subtitle. Its height follows visible content while its width, safe-area padding, and action sizing remain stable. Theme mode is resolved through semantic color tokens rather than a component property.

**Variant axes.** `Icon left`: Yes (default), No · `Header`: No (default), Yes · `Sub header`: No (default), Yes · `Icon right`: No (default), Yes. The extracted set contains 10 valid compositions; subtitle appears only with a title.

### Composition

- `Frame 14481` is a decorative layout wrapper.
- `arrow-left` is a referenced icon component (`13:45`) used as the leading navigation action. This spec owns its placement and semantics, not its glyph internals.

## Flutter V3 implementation contract

`V3Header` is the reusable Flutter mapping of this extracted Figma component. The measured Figma values remain design evidence; runtime behavior extends them where required for production use.

| Runtime concern | Contract |
|---|---|
| App bar integration | Implements `PreferredSizeWidget` and is assigned directly to `Scaffold.appBar`. |
| Safe area | Component มี top padding 12px ตาม Figma และ `preferredSize` ไม่รวม device top inset. `Scaffold` reserves the detected inset and `SafeArea` consumes `MediaQuery.padding.top`; no device-specific height is hardcoded. |
| Theme | Surface uses `background/primary`, divider uses `background/blue`, and text/icons use `content/primary` through `V3ThemeScope` in Light/Dark. |
| Content | `title` and `subtitle` are nullable, localized caller-owned strings; subtitle requires title. |
| Top action row | Nullable `leadingAction` and `topTrailingAction` occupy the left/right edges of the top row. |
| Title action | Nullable `trailingAction` remains aligned to the title row. |
| Action customization | Every slot accepts `V3HeaderAction.icon` as a caller-provided `Widget`; no glyph library is hardcoded. |
| Interaction | `onPressed != null` enables the action. `null` exposes disabled semantics. Each action supports localized label, hint, and tooltip. |
| Accessibility | Visual icon is 24×24; interactive target is 48×48. Text can grow without fixed-height clipping in direct layouts. |
| Preview | Uses `background/primary`, a full-width Light/Dark control, and a live-region `Action: …` feedback label for all three actions. |

Flutter property mapping:

| Figma concept | Flutter API |
|---|---|
| `Header title` | `title` |
| `Subheader` | `subtitle` |
| `Icon left` | `leadingAction` |
| `Icon right` beside title | `trailingAction` |
| Additional top-right control | `topTrailingAction` (runtime extension) |

The implementation source is `v3_header.dart`; usage and token guidance are in `V3_HEADER_GUIDE.md`. When runtime behavior changes, update this section without rewriting the extracted measurements below.

## API

_Confidence: high for the extracted API surface. One specialist vocabulary conflict remains listed in Known gaps._

Page-level header layout. Theme mode is resolved by semantic tokens and is not a component property. Text and action content must be supplied by the consumer in localized form.

### Properties

| Property | Values | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `showLeadingAction` | `true`, `false` | No | `true` | Shows the leading navigation action. The concrete icon and activation behavior are consumer-provided. |
| `showTitle` | `true`, `false` | No | `false` | Shows the primary page title. |
| `showSubtitle` | `true`, `false` | No | `false` | Shows supporting text below the title. Valid only when `showTitle` is true. |
| `showTrailingAction` | `true`, `false` | No | `false` | Shows one contextual action aligned to the trailing edge of the title row, or to the edge of an action-only layout. |
| `title` | `string` | No | `Header title` | Localized primary title content used when `showTitle` is true. |
| `subtitle` | `string` | No | `Subheader` | Localized supporting content used when `showSubtitle` is true. |

### Referenced components

| Component | Figma node | Configuration passed | Spec |
|---|---|---|---|
| `arrow-left` | `13:45` | No variant or boolean overrides; placed at 24×24 as the leading navigation action. | [`./arrow-left.md`](./arrow-left.md) (not yet available) |

### Configuration examples

#### Navigation only

| Property | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `showLeadingAction` | `true` | Provides a back or navigation action. |
| `showTitle` | `false` | Omits textual context. |
| `showSubtitle` | `false` | Subtitle is unavailable without a title. |
| `showTrailingAction` | `false` | No secondary action. |

#### Full contextual header

| Property | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `showLeadingAction` | `true` | Provides navigation. |
| `showTitle` | `true` | Shows the page title. |
| `showSubtitle` | `true` | Shows supporting context. |
| `showTrailingAction` | `true` | Provides a contextual action. |

## Voice / Screen reader

_Confidence: high for the default leading-action configuration._

- Treat the leading arrow as one independent navigation action and give it a concise destination-oriented name such as “Back”; do not announce the icon shape.
- The Header root frame is structural and must not become an extra focus stop.
- Header title and subtitle, when enabled, are readable static text or a heading, not controls.
- Trailing icons are conditional controls: when enabled, give each a purpose-specific accessible name and place it after the title content in focus order.
- Preserve leading-to-trailing reading order across configurations and keep platform behavior aligned.

### showLeadingAction=true

Default Header configuration: leading navigation action visible; title, subtitle, and trailing action hidden.

#### VoiceOver (iOS)

| Focus | Announcement | Order | Property | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Leading navigation action | “Back, button” | 1 | `accessibilityLabel` | `Back` | Use a concise action or destination label; do not use the visual icon name. |
| Leading navigation action | “Back, button” | 1 | `accessibilityTraits` | `.isButton` | Expose the leading navigation action as a button. |
| Leading navigation action | “Back, button” | 1 | `accessibilityHint` | Omit when the Back action is self-explanatory | Add a result-oriented hint only when navigation behavior is unusual. |
| Leading navigation action | “Back, button” | 1 | Do NOT | Do not announce the arrow glyph | Hide the decorative vector inside the button from VoiceOver. |

#### TalkBack (Android)

| Focus | Announcement | Order | Property | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Leading navigation action | “Back, button, double-tap to activate” | 1 | `contentDescription` | `Back` | Use a concise action or destination label; do not use the visual icon name. |
| Leading navigation action | “Back, button, double-tap to activate” | 1 | `role` | `Role.Button` | Expose the leading navigation action as a button. |
| Leading navigation action | “Back, button, double-tap to activate” | 1 | `onClick` | Navigate back | Provide the semantic click action. |
| Leading navigation action | “Back, button, double-tap to activate” | 1 | Do NOT | Do not announce the arrow glyph | Set the child icon content description to null. |

#### ARIA (Web)

| Focus | Announcement | Order | Property | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Leading navigation action | “Back, button” | 1 | native element | `<button type="button">` | Prefer a native button so role, keyboard activation, and focus behavior are implicit. |
| Leading navigation action | “Back, button” | 1 | `aria-label` | `Back` | Required when the button has no visible text label. |
| Leading navigation action | “Back, button” | 1 | `keyboard` | Enter, Space | Native button behavior must remain available. |
| Leading navigation action | “Back, button” | 1 | Do NOT | Do not announce the arrow glyph | Mark the SVG `aria-hidden="true"`. |
